intuition.title: Thermal stability depends on atmosphere
intuition.text: Air annealing at 100 or 200 °C for 2 h retains solubility and shows no oxide by XRD. At 300 °C the sample becomes insoluble, with weak reflections tentatively assigned to CoO and a main peak shift toward Pt-rich alloy. Vacuum treatments at 400 and 500 °C show no crystalline oxide; their duration is not independently stated. CoO/Co3O4 reference sticks are not two observed oxide products.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
